objective: Evaluate Native Open-Detect, DES-v0, and fixed DES-v1 on all 15 frozen VNAT protocols using identical Stage 14C Native checkpoints without retraining or test calibration.
limitations: Natural frozen class prevalence makes AUPRC composition-dependent.
The 15 protocols are paired class compositions from one external dataset, not independent datasets.
Stage 14B Known splits are flow-random and not capture-disjoint.
Preliminary batch-512 outputs are preserved but excluded after a Native validation parity failure.
next_step: Stop after Stage 14D; do not tune or launch another stage.
